03 How we work

One process. One pilot. An improvement you can measure.

We start with the process that takes the most time or causes the longest delays. We establish a baseline and compare the pilot against it: time per task, errors and backlog.

  1. 01

    Map the process

    We identify the tools, the decisions and the points where work gets stuck.

  2. 02

    Test with real cases

    We measure the impact and test how exceptions are handled before authorizing the agent to act.

  3. 03

    Put it into operation

    If the pilot pays off, we activate the workflow and keep a record of what the agent did and what remains open.

  4. 04

    Keep your team in control

    We train your team and agree on how to pause the workflow, who reviews alerts and when to ask for help.

What do you get at handover?

A workflow your team understands and someone who knows how to run it.

  • A guide to the workflow, what it does and what triggers it.
  • Clear access permissions and responsibilities.
  • A way to review activity, spot errors and track spending, based on what we agree.
  • A hands-on session and a plan to keep it running.

Questions you might have

What changes if we already use ChatGPT or Copilot?

In a chat, someone starts each task and takes the answer wherever it needs to go. An agent can start when an email arrives or on a schedule, check several tools and carry out actions you've authorized.

How do I know if it's worth it?

We compare time per task, errors or backlog before and during the pilot. We also account for the cost of implementation and maintenance. We don't promise a savings figure before we've measured it.

How much does it cost?

It depends on the process. Before starting, we agree on the scope and break down the costs of the pilot, tools and maintenance.

Do I need to replace my current tools?

Not necessarily. We first see what we can do with the tools you already use. We only recommend a change if it makes sense after accounting for migration and maintenance.

Who looks after it afterward?

We work with someone on your team so they know what they can handle and when to ask for help. Ongoing support can be agreed separately.

What about my data? What if the AI makes a mistake?

Before connecting anything, we agree on what data the agent can use, which tools it can access and who has permission. We test the workflow before launch and agree on what a person needs to review.

Which process would you improve first?

Think of a process that causes delays, takes too many hours or stops when no one is watching. Tell us how it works today and we'll look at what AI could take on.
